cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've fixed the tap. We'll do this properly: you turn it on, then I'll start the washing-up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Last time your fix sprayed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why I'm supervising this test with a raincoat. You can wear it, and choose how far to open the tap.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wear it, but you're standing beside me. No supervising from the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, close supervision. You take the dry side; I'll stand wherever you say. Just turn it on first so I know I can bring the dishes over.

reason: Make the repairer concede exposure and position to sustain a competent supervision claim while still requiring B to operate the uncertain fix first.
